user.title: Udespa Control
user.description: Pick the devices and check the numbers. Active control starts off, so the integration only watches until you switch it on.

entities.name: Entities
entities.description: The devices Udespa Control works through. It never talks to hardware directly.

data_description.spa: The spa's climate entity. Its current temperature and setpoint drive every rule.
data_description.circulation: On while the spa circulates water. The heat pump may only run while it is on.
data_description.filter_cycle_1: Optional. Only used to name the cycle in Last action.
data_description.filter_cycle_2: Optional. Only used to name the cycle in Last action.
data_description.heat_pump: The heat pump's climate entity. Its own state is never trusted; power confirms it.
data_description.heat_pump_power: Power on the meter phase that carries only the heat pump.
data_description.heater: The switch for the electric heater, used for frost protection and as backup.
data_description.heater_power: Power on the meter phase that carries only the heater.
data_description.outdoor: Entity holding the outdoor temperature, in its state or in the attribute below.
data_description.outdoor_attribute: Leave empty to use the entity's state.
data_description.cleaning_pump: The pump that runs the pipe-cleaning cycles.

numbers.name: Numbers
numbers.description: Timings, thresholds and presets. The defaults are today's measured values.

data_description.off_delay_s: How long the spa must report off before the heat pump is switched off.
data_description.head_start_timeout_s: Head start switches the heat pump off again if no heat call arrives within this time. Keep it below the compressor's start (85–96 s).
data_description.heat_pump_on_w: Power that confirms the heat pump is running.
data_description.heat_pump_off_w: Power that confirms the heat pump has stopped. Must be lower than the running threshold.
data_description.retry_minutes: How long a switch-on or switch-off is retried and verified before it counts as failed.
data_description.backup_margin_c: The backup heater only steps in when the water is this far below the setpoint.
data_description.backup_check_s: How long after switching the heater on its power is checked for the alert.
data_description.heater_on_w: Power that confirms the heater is heating.
data_description.watchdog_interval_min: How often the watchdog checks the heat pump.
data_description.watchdog_circulation_min: The watchdog only acts after circulation has run this long.
data_description.frost_limit_c: Frost protection switches the heater on below this outdoor temperature and off above it.
data_description.in_use_threshold_c: Status is I brug when the setpoint is more than this above the rest temperature.
data_description.cleaning_max_min: Backstop if the spa never stops the cleaning pump itself (it normally does after 15 min).
data_description.cleaning_estimate_min: Shown to dashboards as the expected cycle length.
data_description.preset_quiet: The heat pump's preset for the Lydløs mode.
data_description.preset_smart: The heat pump's preset for the Smart mode.
data_description.preset_turbo: The heat pump's preset for the Turbo mode.
data_description.mode_maintaining: The heat pump's mode while the status is Vedligeholder.
data_description.mode_in_use: The heat pump's mode while the status is I brug.

toggles.name: On/off
toggles.description: Switch individual rules on or off.

data.fault_status: Status Fejl on heat pump failure

data_description.head_start: Switch the heat pump on when circulation starts in I brug, before the spa calls for heat.
data_description.backup_heater: Switch the heater on when the heat pump fails and the water is cold.
data_description.watchdog: Check regularly that the heat pump runs while the water is cold.
data_description.notifications: Send alerts to the notification service.
data_description.fault_status: Show Fejl as the status while a heat pump failure is open.

sources.name: Data sources
sources.description: The values gathered on the Udespa device. Leave a field empty for no copy.

data_description.src_hp_outlet: Source for the heat pump's outlet temperature. Also used for the temperature rise.
data_description.src_hp_ambient: Source for the air temperature at the heat pump.
data_description.src_circulation_power: Power on the meter phase that carries only the circulation pump.
data_description.src_water_ph: The pH value the dashboards show (the corrected one).
data_description.src_water_tds: Source for TDS, if you have one.
data_description.src_ondilo_temperature: The Ondilo's water temperature. Display only; it updates hourly and no rule uses it.
data_description.src_ondilo_battery: Source for the Ondilo's battery level.

reconfigure.title: Swap devices
reconfigure.description: Change the devices without losing entity IDs or stored state.
